title: 1st U.S. Store for Ghibli Goods Opens as Pop-Up in Southern California
content: Viz announced on Monday that Donguri Republic, the store chain in Japan which carries official merchandise from Studio Ghibli and other studios, is opening its first pop-up store in the United States. The store will open at the Del Amo Fashion Center in Torrance, California and will run from June 23 to December 31.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Streams Raunchy Rom-Com Anime I'm Dating a Dark Summoner This October
content: HIDIVE announced that it will exclusively stream the I’m Dating a Dark Summoner anime this October, adapting the manga series created by Shaoh and published by KADOKAWA. WWWave is handling production; the series will be produced under WWWave’s Deregula animation label.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's Trailer Previews Demo
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming a demo trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise, on Monday. The demo launches on Monday, and it includes five missions and the different weapon types.

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in Summer 2026
content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and Crunchyroll is all set to begin streaming dozens of new shows. Apart from the well-known sequels, the latest season will bring several new additions to the anime world.

title: 'Harlequin Original' Magazine Ends Publication
content: The Japanese arm of the Canadian romance publisher Harlequin Enterprises announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that its monthly Harlequin Original magazine has ended its publication with this year's July issue, which shipped on June 11.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Releases Special Trailer for Anime’s Return
content: Black Clover is finally going to be making its return to screens with Season 2 of the anime later this Fall, and it’s getting ready in style with a special trailer showing off everything that happened in the anime so far.
author: ComicBook

title: TV Asahi Announces New Short Anime Programming Block 'PicoAni'
content: TV Asahi announced its new short anime programming block "PicoAni" on Monday, and revealed its lineup of titles, including Koupen-chan , Sirotan , Pop Pap Polters , Momomo! Ninimo , and Josemaru .
author: ANN

title: One Piece Has Confirmed Brook as the Most Tragic Straw Hat
content: One Piece is continuing the Elbaph arc with the release of new chapters, and in the past few chapters, the series has surprisingly dived into Brook’s past and seemingly confirmed that he is the most tragic Straw Hat.
